detail.longDescription: @ Elizafox I share your weariness and frustration about all of the AI slip in open source. I retired in May because of all the pressure to “use more AI”. I tried. I took more time to fix the slip than to write by hand. And at the same time I could feel my skill eroding. I took a break, then started doing political work for a couple local candidates. After the election I plan to pick a foundational open source project and devote serious time to it. It’ll be good to get back to coding, but fighting to tide of slop will be wearisome. # coding # ai # slop # openSource # FOSS
